title: 1978 Chinese Zodiac: Year of the Earth Horse
seo_title: 1978 Chinese Zodiac: Year of the Earth Horse (7 February – 27 January 1979)
description: 1978 is the Year of the Earth Horse (Yang, Wu-wu), from 7 February 1978 to 27 January 1979. Personality, lucky colors and numbers, best matches, and what to know if you were born in January or February 1978.
lead: Born in 1978? Your Chinese zodiac animal is most likely the Horse, but check the date: the 1978 Earth Horse year began on 7 February 1978. Here is everything about the year, from its element to its lucky colors and best matches.
card_text: 1978: Year of the Earth Horse, from 7 February 1978 to 27 January 1979.

image.caption: Illustration from MyBirthSign's zodiac artwork; it is not a photograph.

paras: The Chinese zodiac year 1978 was the Year of the Horse. It began with Lunar New Year on 7 February 1978 and ended on 27 January 1979, the eve of the next Lunar New Year.

Each year also has an element and a Yin or Yang quality. 1978 ends in 8, which makes it an Earth year, and as an even year it is Yang. In the traditional stem-and-branch count, 1978 is a Wu-wu year. The same Earth Horse combination comes round only once every 60 years: 1918 before it and 2038 after it.
Lunar New Year 1978 fell on 7 February 1978, so everyone born in January 1978, and in February before that date, belongs to the previous year's animal, the Snake.

The zodiac year starts at Lunar New Year, not on 1 January, which is why early-year birthdays need checking. Our guide Born in January? explains the rule, and the zodiac sign checker gives the exact answer for any birth date.

Our Horse guide describes the sign like this: “Energetic, independent, and adventurous. Horses love freedom and new experiences.” The usual watch-out: “Can be impatient or struggle to commit long-term.”

The Earth element adds its own flavour. Earth years bring stability, practicality, and patience. People of this element tend to be dependable, grounded, and good at long-term planning. Read more in our Earth element guide, or the full Year of the Horse page.
Careers often linked with the Horse: travel, sales, sports, media.

sections.h2: Best matches for someone born in 1978
paras: In traditional compatibility, the Horse's best matches are the Tiger, Goat and Dog, and its clash sign is the Rat, which sits directly opposite it on the zodiac circle. Our compatibility calculator compares two full birth dates, elements included.
2026 (Fire Horse, until 5 February 2027): for the Horse, 2026 is a Horse year, so Horse people are in their own year (ben ming nian) until 5 February 2027.
2027 (Fire Goat, from 6 February 2027): for the Horse, it is listed as a supportive match of the Goat, so 2027 is traditionally a friendly year. See Chinese zodiac 2027 predictions for every sign.

sections.h2: Other Year of the Horse years
paras: Years of the same animal come every twelve years, each with a different element: 1954 (Wood Horse); 1966 (Fire Horse); 1990 (Metal Horse); 2002 (Water Horse). The full list is in our Chinese zodiac years chart.

faq: 1978 is the Year of the Horse, a Yang Earth Horse year (Wu-wu).
When does the 1978 Year of the Horse start and end?
It starts on 7 February 1978 and ends on 27 January 1979.
I was born in January 1978. What is my Chinese zodiac?
A Snake: Lunar New Year 1978 was on 7 February 1978, so all of January 1978 belongs to the Snake year.
Earth. 1978 ends in 8, which belongs to Earth, and it is a Yang year.
Who is the Horse compatible with?
Traditionally the Tiger, Goat and Dog. The Horse's clash sign is the Rat.
